title: jammy crispy venezuelan scamorza bake
description: a post-workout venezuelan dish featuring scamorza cheese, a dashi extract, and ayurvedic tamasic-friendly ingredients. this sweet and savory bake is perfect for a quick recovery meal.

ingredients.name: dashi extract
ingredients.notes: make sure to use a tamasic-friendly dashi extract

ingredients.name: brown sugar
ingredients.notes: use a small amount to balance the savory flavors

ingredients.name: black sesame seeds
ingredients.notes: optional ingredient for added crunch and nutty flavor

ingredients.name: turmeric
ingredients.notes: optional ingredient for added anti-inflammatory benefits

ingredients.name: ginger
ingredients.notes: optional ingredient for added digestive benefits

ingredients.name: cornstarch
ingredients.notes: used to help crisp the top of the bake

instructions: in a large bowl, mix together the scamorza cheese, brown sugar, black sesame seeds, salt, black pepper, turmeric, and ginger until well combined.
add the dashi extract and mix until the cheese is evenly coated.
transfer the cheese mixture to a greased 8-inch round baking dish.
mix together the coconut oil and cornstarch in a small bowl until well combined.
spread the coconut oil mixture evenly over the top of the cheese mixture.
bake for 20 minutes or until the top is golden brown and the cheese is melted and bubbly.
remove from the oven and let cool for 5 minutes before serving
